objective: Complete the live Obsidian Memory Fabric integration by connecting runtime events and MongoDB operational changes to the derived knowledge vault while preserving all existing authority boundaries.

rulesConsidered: The knowledge layer must remain distinct from runtime and governance authority.
Memory promotion requires provenance and explicit verification.
Ascalon receives bounded evidence-backed projections and cannot amend runtime authority.
Runtime execution must remain independent from Obsidian availability or filesystem latency.

security.reason: The change introduces a bounded backend integration, but it does not expose a new public endpoint or grant Obsidian runtime authority. Secret redaction, provenance gating, idempotent ingestion, quarantine behavior and fail-open runtime isolation are implemented. Strix availability is recorded honestly rather than represented as executed.

verificationPlan: Run vault JSON validation and memory-vault lint.
Run the live Memory Fabric integration test.
Verify MongoDB change-stream failure degrades to bounded reconciliation without stopping FactoryOS.
Verify post-merge main branch required checks before release.

model.name: Ascalon / ShortForge Cognitive Model
model.validationStatus: The integration exposes a bounded verified projection to Ascalon and does not claim a production Ascalon checkpoint or training admission.
